name: Langhof
beschreibung: Gasthof Langhof welcomes visitors to an idyllic setting in the picturesque community of Thiersee in the Kufstein district. Located close to the serene lake waters and surrounded by green meadows and pine forests, this traditional farm inn offers authentic Tyrolean hospitality. Cozy alpine-style rooms feature private balconies framing views across the lake or the rugged limestone peaks of the Kaisergebirge. The rustic tavern parlor serves honest Tyrolean home-style dishes and cold cut platters made with local farm produce. The lakeside setting is a haven for families, hikers, and relaxation seekers year-round.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional farmhouse inn in Thiersee located near the lake shore featuring mountain views and quiet charm.
